title: Wanting an education; going to college deans while on the road
summary: On the Pollack band's one-nighters he asks college deans to let him sit in classes and gets a reading list.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: And I did want to go to the University of Chicago. My mother wanted me to be a doctor and I felt like I would like to study medicine also and interested in it. However, I really, when I got playing with the bands and got around is when I

really realised that the lack of education and I wanted to learn. So I got to go on the road with Ben Pollack's band and orchestra which at that time consisted of Benny Goodman, Glen Miller was also in the band, the Pollack band. And we'd do some one nighters and go around and get up the next day and nothing to do. I thought to myself I ought to go to school.

So it developed I went to this one school in Ohio and I can't remember what school it was. It might have been Ohio University, I don't know. But there was always a college around. And I would go to the dean of the school. Tell him just what I was doing that I had just started my third year in highschool and that I thought I sadly was sadly neglecting my education and I wanted to learn.
And asked what I could do about it. If he could allow me to enter a class and tell me what to do. And they were so interested, they thought that that was so, here's a guy that really wants to learn.
That he said, wonderful, you just come here and I'll put you in classes and you can go in any, I'll set you up in classes and you just go in
as a guest. And I said, I don't know what to read. And he said, I'll give you this one, he said I'll give you ...

A list of books that you should get and so forth and the different subjects and philosophy and so forth. Plato's Government, that was a rough one. And I had to get a big dictionary to find out what the words were. (LAUGHTER). And I did it religiously. I didn't smoke or drink. I didn't, quit smoking, quit drinking for two years.
